message:
Earlier you read the document below and made these notes on it:

<notes>
Brightwell's washing machine and washer-dryer guarantee (UK and NI) sits on top of your statutory rights. Every machine has a 1-year parts and labour guarantee from delivery, and the cover runs for five years in total. Keep proof of purchase showing the delivery date. Covered: repair or replacement of parts failing through manufacturing or material defects — motor, drum bearings, pump, control board, door lock — with labour and call-out included. Not covered: consumables like filters, hoses, fuses and damaged door seals; misuse, accidents, bad installation or foreign objects; cosmetic damage not reported within 7 days of delivery; commercial use (launderettes, salons, care homes, guest houses with more than three rooms); appliances outside the UK and NI; and work by non-Brightwell engineers. Use only Brightwell-approved detergents, as using other or own-brand products voids the guarantee, and overdosing counts as misuse. If an engineer finds no fault or an excluded cause, a £75 call-out fee is charged. Most repairs happen at home; if a workshop repair is needed, you must arrange transport to and from the workshop. Replacements are covered for the rest of the original period. The guarantee moves with you within the UK. Claims: 0300 555 0142, Monday–Saturday 8:00–20:00, or online.
</notes>

Here is the document itself, for reference:

<document>
BRIGHTWELL HOME APPLIANCES — 5-YEAR PARTS AND LABOUR GUARANTEE FOR WASHING MACHINES AND WASHER-DRYERS (UK and Northern Ireland)

This guarantee is given by Brightwell Home Appliances UK Ltd in addition to your statutory rights, which are not affected.

1. Standard guarantee. Every Brightwell washing machine and washer-dryer comes with a 1-year parts and labour guarantee from the date of delivery, which applies automatically.

2. Extended guarantee. The guarantee is extended to a total of 5 years parts and labour provided that the appliance is registered with Brightwell, online or by telephone, within 28 days of delivery. If the appliance is not registered within 28 days, only the 1-year standard guarantee applies, and repairs in years 2 to 5 will be chargeable. Proof of purchase showing the date of delivery must be kept for the whole guarantee period.

3. What is covered. Repair or, at Brightwell's option, replacement of any part that fails because of a manufacturing or material defect, including the motor, drum bearings, pump, control board and door lock. Labour and engineer call-out charges for covered repairs are included.

4. What is not covered. (a) Consumable items, including door seals damaged by foreign objects, filters, hoses and fuses. (b) Damage caused by misuse, accidents, incorrect installation, use of incorrect electricity supply, or foreign objects such as coins and underwire left in the drum. (c) Cosmetic damage, unless reported within 7 days of delivery. (d) Appliances used for commercial purposes, including launderettes, hair and beauty salons, care homes, and guest houses with more than three letting rooms. (e) Appliances installed outside the UK and Northern Ireland. (f) Repairs carried out, or attempted, by anyone other than a Brightwell-authorised engineer.

5. Detergents. You may use any detergent or capsule labelled as suitable for automatic washing machines. Using non-Brightwell or supermarket own-brand detergents does not affect this guarantee. However, damage caused by excessive detergent dosing contrary to the instructions in the user manual is treated as misuse.

6. No fault found. If an engineer attends and finds no fault with the appliance, or finds that the problem is caused by something excluded under section 4, you will be charged a call-out fee of £75.

7. Workshop repairs. Most repairs are carried out in your home. If the engineer decides that the appliance must be repaired in a workshop, Brightwell will arrange and pay for collection and return delivery. You must ensure the appliance is disconnected and accessible on the agreed date.

8. Replacement appliances. If Brightwell replaces the appliance, the replacement is covered for the remainder of the original guarantee period only.

9. Moving house. The guarantee transfers with the appliance if you move within the UK and Northern Ireland, and passes to a new owner if the appliance is sold with the property, provided Brightwell is notified.

10. How to claim. Call the Brightwell Service Line on 0300 555 0142 (Monday to Saturday, 8:00–20:00) or book online. Have your model number, serial number and proof of purchase ready.
</document>

A few questions from someone who needs to act on this:
1. We never registered our machine. The pump failed in year three. Is the repair free under the guarantee?
2. I always use supermarket own-brand washing capsules at the recommended dose. Does that void the guarantee?
3. How soon after delivery must cosmetic damage be reported to be covered?
4. The engineer says our registered machine must go to the workshop for a covered repair. Do we have to arrange a van?
response:
Answers are below, taken from the document itself. Three of these points contradict my earlier notes, which were wrong.

**1. Unregistered machine, pump failed in year three: not free.**
The 5-year cover only applies if the machine was registered with Brightwell within 28 days of delivery (section 2). Without registration, only the 1-year standard guarantee applies, and "repairs in years 2 to 5 will be chargeable." My notes wrongly said the five-year cover was automatic.

**2. Supermarket own-brand capsules at the recommended dose: does not void it.**
Section 5 says you may use any detergent or capsule labelled as suitable for automatic washing machines, and that using non-Brightwell or own-brand products "does not affect this guarantee." The only risk is damage from overdosing beyond the manual's instructions, which counts as misuse. At the recommended dose, you're fine. My notes had this backwards.

**3. Cosmetic damage: report it within 7 days of delivery** (section 4(c)).

**4. Workshop repair on a registered machine: no van needed.**
Brightwell arranges and pays for collection and return delivery (section 7). You only need to make sure the machine is disconnected and accessible on the agreed date. My notes wrongly said you had to arrange transport.

One more correction: my notes listed "damaged door seals" as excluded in general. The document only excludes door seals damaged by foreign objects.

To book a repair, call 0300 555 0142 (Mon–Sat, 8:00–20:00) or book online. Have your model number, serial number and proof of purchase ready.
